definitions.gloss: a big eater; someone with a large appetite; a glutton
definitions.explanation: a person who eats large quantities of food
a competition to see who can eat the most food in a given time

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大食|おおぐ}いだ。
examples.english: My younger brother is a big eater.

examples.english: I spend a lot on food because I'm a big eater.

notes:
FORMS:
{大|おお} (big, large) + {食|ぐ}い (eating) → big eating

FUNCTIONS:
- As a noun: {大食|おおぐ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a big eater)
- As a na-adjective: {大食|おおぐ}いな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person who eats a lot)

TV ENTERTAINMENT:
{大食|おおぐ}い⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧ (competitive eating shows) are popular in Japan. Famous competitive eaters (⟦フード→フード：28535_fuudo⟧ファイター) become celebrities.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大食|おおぐ}い (big eater) - eats large quantities
- ⟦{少食|しょうしょく}→少食：08480_shoushoku⟧ (light eater) - eats small quantities
- ⟦{早食|はやぐ}い→早食い：08481_hayagui⟧ (fast eater) - eats quickly

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to eat a lot)
- ⟦{食|く}いしん{坊|ぼう}→食いしん坊：16180_kuishinbou⟧ (glutton, foodie)
- {腹|はら}ペコ (hungry, starving)
